images.caption:
Watts Towers — built by Sabato Rodia, an Italian immigrant who lived in the area from the 1920s to 1954. He constructed this complex over a period of 33 years. 

The towers were saved from demolition by Los Angeles architects, artists, and activists in with foresight, and eventually preserved.
California Historical Landmark No. 993.
This is my first-ever visit to Watts Towers and the surrounding working-class neighborhood.

images.caption:
Watts Towers, California Historical Landmark No. 993, were built by Sabato Rodia, an Italian immigrant who lived in the area in the 1920s. He constructed this complex over a period of 33 years. Rodia, having suffered abuse from neighbors, abandoned the project and left in 1955, never coming back and passing away in Martinez, Northern California, in 1965. The towers were saved from demolition by other neighbors with foresight, and eventually preserved.

This is my first-ever visit to Watts Towers and the surrounding working-class neighborhood.
